description: This source file defines the ModelScreenCondition class, which models <condition> XML elements used in the OFBiz framework's widget screen configuration. It contains inner classes for specific condition types, such as IfEmptySection, and a factory class for creating condition instances from XML elements.

classes.name: ModelScreenCondition
classes.description: Represents the <condition> element in widget screen XML configuration, providing mechanisms to evaluate conditions based on XML attributes and context data.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing ModelConditionVisitor to perform operations on this condition instance.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the condition against a provided context map, returning true if the condition holds.

methods.name: getSectionExdr
methods.description: Returns the FlexibleStringExpander instance used to expand the 'section-name' attribute.

inner_classes.name: IfEmptySection
inner_classes.description: A specific condition class that checks if a specified section is empty in the context.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates whether the specified section is empty in the current context.

methods.name: getSectionExdr
methods.description: Returns the string expander for the section name.

inner_classes.name: ScreenConditionFactory
inner_classes.description: A factory class for creating ModelCondition instances based on XML elements.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new condition instance based on the provided XML element.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Method to accept a visitor, part of Visitor pattern implementation.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the condition with the given context map.
